title: 🎨 Palette: Standardize quest progress bars and improve button accessibility
body:
Implemented micro-UX improvements focused on accessibility:
- Standardized quest objective progress bars using the WAI-ARIA `progressbar` pattern in both the Quest Journal and the HUD Quest Preview.
- Improved the accessibility of equipment unequip buttons by adding `aria-label` attributes.
Verified that changes maintain the existing visual style while providing critical context to assistive technologies.
